metadata.title: Quantum Invariants indexed by Fibered Faces of the Thurston Polytope
metadata.abstract: We study the Gukov--Manolescu quantum invariant for oriented links. While this invariant is a single series in the knot case, we find that links admit multiple such series, each one consistent with the Melvin--Morton--Rozansky expansion of the colored Jones polynomials. We prove that convergent inverted state sums yield a family of multivariable Gukov--Manolescu series, indexed by monomials of the Alexander polynomial. We conjecture that these monomials correspond precisely to the fibered faces of the Thurston norm ball and provide extensive computational evidence for this correspondence. Further results concerning the leading term, the corresponding single-variable invariant, and the effect of partial Dehn surgery are also established.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 构造链环的多变量 Gukov–Manolescu 级数族，以 Alexander 多项式单项式索引，并研究首项、单变量化和部分 Dehn 手术的影响。
analysis.breakthrough: 提出级数索引与 Thurston 范数球纤维化面的对应，并提供计算证据。
analysis.limitations: 纤维化面对应在摘要中明确为猜想，不能与已证明的收敛状态和构造混同。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 连接量子拓扑与三维流形几何，计算可为理论发展提供线索。
